subject: The 2AM hack power users swear by
preview_text: This shortcut will save you time and guilt. See it now.
body_paragraphs: You know that feeling when you measure out the exact right amount of kibble, only to second-guess yourself and add 'just a little more'? I've been there. But here's what the power users of PupShape figured out early: there's a hidden workflow that eliminates the guesswork entirely.

They don't waste time debating portion sizes or worrying about treat calories. Instead, they use a shortcut inside the app that syncs their dog's meal plan with a daily 'what I can actually feed' checklist. It's like having a cheat sheet that turns confusion into confidence.

Here's the feature they whisper about in dog parks: the 'Quick Log' button in your dashboard. Tap it once, and it pulls up your dog's exact meal plan for today—including treats and snack allowances—based on their latest weight and activity. No scrolling, no math, no guilt.

Open PupShape right now, tap 'Quick Log,' and see how simple it feels. Then tell your pup they're getting the VIP treatment. P.S. This shortcut also highlights the best time to sneak in a walk—based on your dog's breed and energy levels.
